units: meters; baked GLB asset-root +Y up, +Z front

bedSurface.definition: vertical top hit below Y=.48, Y in (.367,.39), geometric normal.y>.97; approximate sampled near-horizontal bed face, edge resolution 2.5mm

ramFootprint.definition: ram first upward hit, underside Y<.555; sampled actual low platen footprint

oldCalibration.note: Bounds converted from sourceBedSampleBoxBlender using recorded sourceBaseCenter/sourceToMetersScale. Old pipeline selects vertices inside a height-limited 3D box, then max Y; it does not raycast the workbed top.
